schema.description:
What an engine-run plan stage asks Claude to return: [`PlanProposal`]'s strict form. Structured
output refuses an open object, so each item's props are name-value pairs, and the engine maps
the reply back to a `PlanProposal` before it checks and writes it. Like the proposal, it is
read once and never stored on its own, so it carries no `format` tag.

items.description: The stage's items, new and re-proposed.

key.description: The item's key: a new one, or an existing item's to re-propose it.

parent.description:
A key of this reply, a key of the slice's items, or `project`; null keeps an existing
item's parent and puts a new one under the project.

items.description: One prop of a drafted item.

value.description: A prop's value: text, or a list of text.

touches.description: Block IDs from the slice's targets.

content.text: {"items":[{"key":"retry-storm","name":"Retries pile onto a struggling dependency","parent":"project","props":[{"name":"story","value":"A dependency slows down and every failing job retries at once. The extra load keeps it down, retries multiply, and an outage that would have passed in minutes lasts for hours."},{"name":"likelihood","value":"medium"},{"name":"mitigation","value":"Use exponential backoff with jitter and cap how many retries run at the same time."}],"touches":[],"type":"risk"},{"key":"permanent-misread","name":"A permanent failure is classed as transient","parent":"project","props":[{"name":"story","value":"An unmapped error type defaults to retryable, so invalid input is retried to the attempt limit. Each job wastes its whole retry budget and the failure surfaces late."},{"name":"likelihood","value":"high"},{"name":"mitigation","value":"Treat unknown errors as permanent by default and list retryable errors explicitly, with a test for each class."}],"touches":[],"type":"risk"},{"key":"duplicate-side-effects","name":"A retried job repeats its side effects","parent":"project","props":[{"name":"story","value":"A job fails after charging or sending a message but before it is marked done. The retry runs it again and the customer is charged or notified twice."},{"name":"likelihood","value":"high"},{"name":"mitigation","value":"Check that each job type is idempotent before enabling retries for it, and enable retries per job type."}],"touches":[],"type":"risk"},{"key":"silent-exhaustion","name":"Exhausted retries go unnoticed","parent":"project","props":[{"name":"story","value":"Jobs use up their attempts and are dropped with only a log line. Nobody sees them until a customer reports missing work, so people still rerun by hand."},{"name":"likelihood","value":"medium"},{"name":"mitigation","value":"Emit an exhaustion counter and alert on it as part of the retry visibility work."}],"touches":[],"type":"risk"},{"key":"attempt-count-lost","name":"Attempt counts reset on worker restart","parent":"project","props":[{"name":"story","value":"The attempt count lives in memory. A deploy restarts the worker mid-retry, the count resets, and a job runs past its configured maximum."},{"name":"likelihood","value":"low"}],"touches":[],"type":"risk"},{"key":"idempotency-audit","name":"Audit job types for idempotency, for duplicate-side-effects","parent":"retry-runner","props":[{"name":"verb","value":"audit"},{"name":"done_test","value":"Each job type is listed as idempotent or excluded from retries, and the list is reviewed"},{"name":"context","value":"worker repo, job handlers"}],"touches":[],"type":"next_action"},{"key":"default-unknown-permanent","name":"Default unknown errors to permanent, for permanent-misread","parent":"classify-failures","props":[{"name":"verb","value":"default"},{"name":"done_test","value":"A unit test shows an unmapped error type is flagged permanent and not retried"},{"name":"context","value":"worker repo, Go, failure classification"}],"touches":[],"type":"next_action"}]}
